# The Spectrum Institute (TSI)

> The Spectrum Institute (TSI Spectrum) is a technical, safety and professional education institute in Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, with a main campus in Barikot and a city campus in Mingora. It offers safety courses (NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA), IT and AI courses, languages and academic coaching.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://spectruminstitute.uk/): overview of the institute
- [News & Student Achievements](https://spectruminstitute.uk/news.html): latest news, results and success stories of TSI students. Each story has its own page under https://spectruminstitute.uk/news/
- [Courses](https://spectruminstitute.uk/courses.html): full course catalog
- [Faculty](https://spectruminstitute.uk/faculty.html): teacher profiles
- [Shah Mujeeb ur Rahman](https://spectruminstitute.uk/shah-mujeeb-ur-rahman.html): profile of the Lead IT & AI Specialist at TSI (AI Engineering and Cyber Security trainer, Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa)
- [Alumni](https://spectruminstitute.uk/alumni.html): former students and where they work now
- [Student Gallery](https://spectruminstitute.uk/gallery.html): photos and achievements
- [Admissions](https://spectruminstitute.uk/admissions.html): how to apply
- [Certificate Verification](https://spectruminstitute.uk/verify.html): verify a TSI certificate
- [Contact](https://spectruminstitute.uk/contact.html): phone numbers and campus addresses
